mfa.sms_enroll_description: Enter the mobile number that should receive your sign-in codes.
mfa.email_description: Enter the code we emailed you.
mfa.sms_description: Enter the code we texted you.

account.sign_in_description: Sign in through your organisation to manage your profile, sign-in security, connected applications and data.
account.invalid_tenant: Enter your organisation's identifier: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
account.mfa_description: A second step protects your account even if your password is exposed.
account.mfa_required_hint: Your organisation requires a second step when you sign in.
account.mfa_none: No second step is set up yet.
account.app_hint: Scan the code with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, 1Password or Authy, then enter the code it shows.
account.remove_hint: You will no longer be able to use it for your second step.
account.remove_last_hint: This is your only second step. Removing it also discards your recovery codes; your organisation may ask you to set one up again when you sign in.
account.codes_description: If you lose your second step, a recovery code lets you sign in. Each works once.
account.codes_renew_hint: Your current recovery codes stop working and a new set is shown once.
account.devices_description: Browsers where you chose not to be asked for your second step again.
account.orgs_description: The organizations you belong to. Sign in again to act in another one.
account.orgs_none: You do not belong to any organization.
account.profile_description: Changes are saved as you make them.
account.locale_hint: Used for emails and pages from your organisation.
account.profile_no_fields: Your organisation has not added any profile fields.
account.contact_description: A code sent to the new address or number confirms it before it replaces the current one.
account.change_email_hint: We will send a code to the new address. Your current address stays until the code is entered.
account.change_phone_hint: We will text a code to the new number. Use the international format, starting with +.
account.remove_phone_hint: Your organisation will no longer be able to reach you by text message.
account.password_none: You have no password; you sign in another way.
account.password_must_change: Your organisation asks you to change it.
account.password_done_signed_out_one: Your password was changed and {count} other session was signed out.
account.password_done_signed_out_other: Your password was changed and {count} other sessions were signed out.
account.sessions_description: Every browser with a live session. Ending one signs it out and cancels the tokens it was given.
account.impersonation_banner: {admin} is signed in as {user}. Changing credentials, consent and deleting the account are turned off. The session ends {when}.
account.apps_description: Applications you allowed to use your account, and what they may see.
account.apps_none: No application has access to your account.
account.app_remove_hint: The application is signed out of your account and asks for permission again the next time you use it.
account.export_description: A JSON file with everything held about you: your profile, sign-in methods, devices, sessions, connected applications, roles, groups and activity. Passwords and keys are never included.
account.delete_description: Signs you out everywhere and removes your account. Your organisation keeps the record for a short period before it is erased.
account.delete_hint: This cannot be undone. Applications that rely on this account stop working.
login.broker.denied: The sign-in was cancelled at the provider.
login.broker.upstream: The provider could not sign you in. Try again or use another method.
login.broker.invalid_state: That sign-in has expired or was already used. Start again.
login.broker.email_in_use: An account with that email address already exists. Sign in the usual way, then link the provider from your account page.
login.broker.already_linked: That account is already linked to another user.
login.broker.account_disabled: Your account is disabled. Contact your organisation.
account.identities_description: Sign in with an account you hold elsewhere. Linking one takes you to that provider and back.
account.identity_unlink_hint: You will no longer be able to sign in with it. Make sure you have another way to sign in.
device.invalid_code: That code was not recognised. Check the code on your device and try again.
account.tokens_description: Long-lived tokens for scripts and integrations. Each does only what you allow it, and never more than you may do yourself.
account.tokens_new_hint: The token is shown once, right after it is made.
account.token_scopes_hint: Your account, and the administration rights you hold. If you lose a right, tokens lose it too.
account.token_scope_account: Act on my account (the account API)
account.token_expiry_optional: Leave empty for a token that never expires.
account.token_minted_hint: Copy it now. It is not shown again.
account.token_revoke_hint: Anything using this token stops working at once.
